_doc: A-P1-NORM-1107: deterministic lay/garbled-wording -> field-term mapping for vera/query_norm.py. SEED / FALLBACK ONLY (owner rule: a curated table is a DB table; the DB table, when it exists, is read through query_norm.set_db_rows and overrides this seed). Closed, owner-curated list; the same terms are the ONLY vocabulary an LLM rewrite may pick from.
source: Planner/implementer seed v1, 2026-11-07, A-P1-NORM-1107: hand-written pairs of everyday phrasing and the standard textbook field term (e.g. stellar nucleosynthesis, myocardial infarction). Not harvested from the corpus and not measured on real queries.
_calibration_note: UNCALIBRATED. Membership and triggers are not measured on real data. Method before 'on': run the shadow log (stage query_norm) and the WP-E replay; for every entry count questions that trigger it and that the held corpus already answers (must stay answered) and the off-topic admit rate with the term appended (must not rise). Add an entry only if its trigger words do not collide with another field's common wording.
